overall_disposition: SUSPECTED_FINDINGS_REQUIRE_OWNER_TRIAGE; not a clean scan claim.
disclosure_policy: No matched values, source snippets, or exception messages retained or printed. Only hashed finding IDs and paths are retained for suspected findings.
owner: Coordinator/security owner must classify suspected findings before further affected-content disclosure or publication.
execution: No member extraction, installation, repository-record execution, tests, builds, linters, index operations, commits, or pushes.
limits: Historical missing logs cannot be rescanned. Existing receipt reused only for exact size/hash matches. No nested-archive recursion or arbitrary binary format decoding. Default detect-secrets heuristic and allowlist filters apply.
